mapper.select: select group_id, venue, player_count, reporter_user_id, reporter_display_name, reported_at, created_at, updated_at from arcade_occupancy_report where group_id = #{groupId} and venue = #{venue}
mapper.insert: insert into arcade_occupancy_report ( group_id, venue, player_count, reporter_user_id, reporter_display_name, reported_at ) values ( #{groupId}, #{venue}, #{playerCount}, #{reporterUserId}, #{reporterDisplayName}, #{reportedAt} ) on duplicate key update player_count = values(player_count), reporter_user_id = values(reporter_user_id), reporter_display_name = values(reporter_display_name), reported_at = values(reported_at), updated_at = current_timestamp
